universe: Regular season NHL skaters with all three predictions archived before scheduled puck drop; one player-game, earliest complete daily snapshot; F/D diagnostics only. Report missing predictions, absent players and unknown outcomes explicitly; do not map absence to zero.

benchmarks.frozen_reference: Tracked GOAL17 bundle frozen at 2024-02-01; no refit
benchmarks.player_smoothed: (season_goal_hits_before_match + 10 * fit_partition_goal_prevalence) / (season_games_before_match + 10); same strict daily cutoff; no test outcomes

top_decile: ceil(0.10*n) per NHL date, ties by game_id then player_id; pooled hits and n

decision.paired_ci: 10000 moving date-block bootstrap replicates, block 7 dates, seed 20261016; Bonferroni family 2, upper 97.5% two-sided logloss-difference CI < 0 for both benchmarks
decision.season_phase_stability: log loss and Brier improve against both benchmarks in Nov-Dec, Jan-Feb and Mar-Apr; missing phase is inconclusive
decision.promotion: All criteria required; human review, never automatic

analysis: One final analysis after end and finalized outcomes. No interim predictive-metric inspection or selection. Technical coverage/integrity diagnostics allowed only. Insufficient sample => inconclusive; no post-result extension.
missing: Only confirmed final player statistics count as labels; unresolved/DNP excluded with counts published. Common eligible universe for comparisons; publish total roster and each missing-reason count.
corrections: Append final corrected outcomes; freeze evaluation extraction 2027-04-27T00:00:00Z. Bug fixes limited to identity/temporal/ingestion/storage/matching; separate comparability assessment and version before use; incomparable predictions cannot count toward V1 promotion.
pp: UNKNOWN unless freshness verified; no probability changes or PP-filter promotion in this protocol
historical_results: All prior holdouts consumed; no independent evidence claimed from them
betting: No ROI or betting-policy selection without independent reliable timestamped odds; model remains research-only until final decision
